restaurant_info.description: Anmol Sweets & Restaurant brings the authentic flavors of India and Pakistan to Sweden. We specialize in traditional sweets, savory dishes, and full-service catering for all occasions.

dine_in.description: Enjoy our authentic cuisine in a warm, welcoming atmosphere

takeaway.description: Order your favorite dishes for pickup

catering.description: Full-service catering for weddings, parties, and corporate events

reservations.description: Book your table online for a guaranteed spot

lunch_buffet.description: All-you-can-eat lunch buffet with rotating dishes

menu_categories.name: Appetizers
menu_categories.description: Start your meal with these delicious starters

popular_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
popular_dishes.description: Authentic Karachi Style Chicken Biryani. Flavourful, layered rice dish made with tender chicken, potatoes, aromatic long-grain basmati rice, and a secret blend of spices. Served with raita.

popular_dishes.name: Butter Chicken
popular_dishes.description: Tender chicken in rich, creamy tomato sauce

popular_dishes.name: Palak Paneer
popular_dishes.description: Fresh, house-made paneer cheese, gently simmered in a vibrant, creamy spinach gravy infused with ginger, garlic, and aromatic spices.

popular_dishes.name: Chicken Karahi
popular_dishes.description: Sizzling, robust classic cooked fresh to order in a traditional wok. Bone-in chicken flash-cooked with fresh tomatoes, ginger, green chilies, and black pepper.

popular_dishes.name: Chicken Achari
popular_dishes.description: Uniquely tangy and spicy curry made with traditional Indian pickling spices (fennel, mustard seeds, nigella seeds). Bold and zesty.

popular_dishes.name: Chicken Samosa
popular_dishes.description: Golden, flaky pastry triangle, handmade fresh daily and stuffed with spiced minced chicken and peas. Served with mint and tamarind chutneys.

popular_dishes.name: Chana Chaat
popular_dishes.description: Vibrant, fresh salad made with tender chickpeas, soft boiled potatoes, crisp onions, tomatoes, lemon juice and tangy chaat masala. Naturally vegan.

popular_dishes.name: Rasmalai
popular_dishes.description: Delicate, soft sponge discs of fresh house-made paneer soaked in creamy, sweetened milk perfumed with saffron and cardamom.

popular_dishes.name: Rasmalai Cake
popular_dishes.description: Spectacular fusion dessert. Soft cardamom sponge sponge cake layered with saffron and pistachio cream frosting, soaked in sweet milk.

popular_dishes.name: Halwa Puri Platter
popular_dishes.description: Legendary weekend breakfast. Hot fluffy puri breads, savory chickpea curry (Lahori channay), and sweet semolina pudding (suji halwa).

popular_dishes.name: Classic Coconut Biscuits
popular_dishes.description: Freshly baked Kokoskakor with a perfect chewy and buttery texture. Perfect for fika.

vegetarian.description: We have a large and beloved vegetarian menu! Our most famous dish is the Palak Paneer (house-made paneer).

vegan.description: Yes, several of our dishes are naturally vegan.

gluten_free.description: Most curries and rice dishes are naturally gluten-free

halal.description: Yes, we proudly offer a wide menu of Halal dishes, prepared according to proper standards.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We are located at Fagerstagatan 13, 163 53 Spånga, Stockholm, Sweden.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Mon-Fri: 10:00 – 20:00, Sat-Sun: 10:00 – 19:00. Lunch Buffet Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00. Weekend Breakfast 10:30-14:00.

faqs.question: Do you have a lunch buffet?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have Stockholm's best-value workday lunch buffet (Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00) for 139 SEK. Includes rotating hot dishes (chicken, meat, veg), salad bar, naan, rice, raita, coffee/tea, and dessert.

faqs.question: Do you have a breakfast buffet?
faqs.answer: On weekends (Sat & Sun 10:30-14:00), we serve our legendary Halwa Puri breakfast buffet for 129 SEK. Includes fresh puris, Lahori channay, and suji halwa.

faqs.question: Do you do catering?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in authentic Indian/Pakistani catering for weddings, parties, corporate functions, and festivals. We create custom menus to suit your event.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver in the Stockholm area. Some weekend specials like Halwa Puri are restricted to specific zones for freshness.

faqs.question: Do you sell cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, our in-house Anmol Bakery creates custom cakes for all occasions (birthdays, weddings). Famous for our fusion Rasmalai Cake and themed cakes.

faqs.question: What is Halwa Puri?
faqs.answer: It's our legendary weekend breakfast platter featuring hot fluffy puris (fried bread), savory chickpea curry (Lahori channay), and sweet semolina pudding (suji halwa).

faqs.question: I have a nut allergy. Is your food safe?
faqs.answer: Our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, and gluten extensively. While we take precautions, we cannot guarantee zero cross-contamination. Please inform staff but consume at your own risk.

faqs.question: Do you have parking?
faqs.answer: Yes, parking facilities are available nearby on Fagerstagatan.

faqs.question: Do you sell gift cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer gift cards! Purchase them in-store at our restaurant in Spånga.

faqs.question: Do you sell groceries?
faqs.answer: Yes, we sell high-quality ingredients and products like ready-to-cook Papadums, both in-store and online.

faqs.question: What is the Anmol Electric Tandoor?
faqs.answer: It's a versatile countertop appliance we sell for home use. Great for baking naan, pizza, and roti. Premium German Standard.
